cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 allocates rescue tasks, A3 dismisses mug causation while fetching food, and A5 chooses the mug as both rescue and clue disposal.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 diet to rescue the lease and remove incriminating words at once.
